Review of Inverses (from Algebra)

There are guided examples and further examples given in this video.  Pause the video to give yourself enough time to work through the further examples.  If you get them correct, you can fast forward through the explanations.  When the slide changes, that is when new material will occur.  The review information about Inverse Functions can also be found in our textbook in Chapter 1, Section 6.
 


Review of Rational Zero Test (Solving Polynomials using Synthetic Division)

Here is a resource to use if you need to refresh how to use the the rational zero test.  This skills uses synthetic division to find when a polynomial equals zero.

The review information about Solving polynomials can also be found in our textbook.  This in Chapter 2 Section 3 and includes the synthetic division skill. Pg 119 and Pgs 122-124 may be helpful.  Especially examples 8 and 9 pn Pg 124 & Pg 124
